ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_bayesian_pairwise_probability_gap_sigmoid_weighted
ir.intuition: This loss reinterprets pairwise preference as a probabilistic binary classification task, leveraging a Bayesian-inspired sigmoid likelihood over the log-probability differences. Instead of margin ranking, it models the probability that the winning sequence is preferred over the losing one, weighted by the absolute advantage gap, promoting probabilistic consistency and smoother gradients. Weight normalization ensures stable learning.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
prob = sigmoid(clamp(margin, -10, 10))
log_likelihood = log(prob + 1e-8)
weighted_loss = -log_likelihood * abs(adv_gap)
if weight exists:
  norm_weight = weight / clamp(sum(weight), 1e-6, 1e6)
  weighted_loss *= norm_weight
loss = mean(weighted_loss)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    prob = ops.sigmoid(clamped_margin)
    eps = 1e-8
    log_likelihood = ops.log(ops.add(prob, eps))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(ops.neg(log_likelihood), ops.abs(adv_gap))
    if weight is not None:
        weight_sum = ops.clamp(ops.sum(weight), 1e-6, 1e6)
        norm_weight = ops.div(weight, weight_sum)
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, norm_weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
